end.summary:
Practised sorting numbers into odd and even by making pairs and checking the ones digit.
Answered 2 of 4 pairing attempts and 2 of 3 ones-digit attempts without help.
Corrected the idea that 34 is odd because it contains the digit 3; used complete pairs to identify 34 as even.
Continued to question whether zero is even, so this point was not yet corrected.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Jiya practised making pairs and checking the ones digit to identify odd and even numbers. They used the pairing method to correct the mix-up about 34, and also identified 58 and 142 as even. They still need practice understanding that zero is even and that the last digit determines a whole number’s parity; at home, try pairing zero objects and checking numbers such as 20, 40, and 70 together.
